name: The Wager
source:
A stranger in the pub’s backroom invites you to a three-round game. Victory or defeat comes at a cost.

First your belongings, then your memories. Biscuits slide across the table. Will you eat?

[From [url=https://abstractedvoices.itch.io/the-wager]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
酒吧后室的一个陌生人邀请你参加一场三轮游戏。胜利或失败都是有代价的。

首先是你的物品，然后是你的记忆。饼干滑过桌子。你会吃吗？

[来自[url=https://abstractedvoices.itch.io/the-wager]Itch.io[/url]]
